svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pan 490 x 430 x 25 deep from 1 mm sheet: blank 540 x 480 with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre cut out to leave an 8 mm rim (inner 474 x 414). Fold the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four sides up 25 at the 490 x 430 lines; the rim becomes an inward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom lip. Notch and rivet the corners; seal them with silicone.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: seven aluminium flat bars 6 x 1.5, 428 long, on edge at 60

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pitch, resting on the lip; a PTFE-coated glass-fibre mesh (about

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1.8 mm aperture), 488 x 428, on top. The sorbent holds it down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Coat the pan inside and the bars with black PTFE at a coating shop;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Absorber plate: 1 mm perforated aluminium, 3 mm holes at 6 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: staggered pitch, 484 x 424, two 25 mm finger holes 25 in from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: short ends; black PTFE both faces. It rests on the levelled bed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: EPDM gasket tape under the lip, all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the lip sits on the baffle gasket over its opening; 13 to 23 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the walls, 14 mm between trays.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the floor sags less than 3 mm with 1 kg spread on it.
